shared_elements: schematic linear/incised marks on a rock surface
rows of repeated short strokes or crew-like tally marks
circular/disc-like motifs (weak: A has none clear; B has rings)
justification: A depicts overlapping profile boats with upturned prows, rows of crew strokes and a small standing figure, while B is a massive frontal anthropomorphic figure with a head, arms folded on the belly, and low-relief rings and curved bands on its back. Beyond a shared reliance on flat schematic linear motifs, there is no shared subject, relationship or arrangement; boats and repeated crew strokes have no counterpart in the standing figure's ring-and-band decoration.
